source_text: Εἰς τὸ ὄρος ἄνεισι δεικνύς, ὅτι ὁ χθαμαλὸς νοῦς οὐκ ἂν γένοιτο πρὸς θεωρίαν ἐπιτήδειος, ἀλλ' ὁ κατ' ἰδίαν γεγονὼς καὶ ἔξω φροντίδων βιωτικῶν ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.
pass_a_gloss: Into the mountain he-goes-up showing, that the lowly mind not would become toward contemplation suitable, but the according to own having-become and outside of cares of life in quiet.
pass_b_english: He goes up onto the mountain to show that a lowly mind would not become fit for contemplation, but the one who has become his own, outside life’s cares, in quiet (Matthew 17:1).
